brief: Build a modern stock screening website with a clean and professional design similar to Finviz or Tickertape. The homepage should have a dashboard showing major market indices, top gainers, top losers, and trending stocks. Add a stock screener where users can filter stocks by market cap, price, sector, P/E ratio, dividend yield, volume, and 52-week high/low. Display the results in a sortable table with company name, ticker symbol, current price, daily change, market cap, and volume. When a user clicks on a stock, open a detailed page showing the company profile, current price, price chart, key financial metrics, recent news, and basic technical indicators. Include a search bar, responsive design for desktop and mobile, smooth animations, dark and light mode, loading animations, and a clean finance-themed UI. The website should fetch live stock data from a free API instead of using mock data.
